name: Shiawase na NEET no Sodatekata
original_name: 幸せなニートの育て方
source: Living together with NEET-chan. It is a game where you first become friends through communication, teach the ignorant NEET the joy of life and both of you become happy together.
translation: 和尼特女孩一起生活吧。先從聊天開始，慢慢成為朋友，再帶著這個涉世未深的女孩體會生活的樂趣，一起過上幸福的日子。
